canonical_name: Voyager -- An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models (Wang, Xie, Jiang, Mandlekar, Xiao, Zhu, Fan, Anandkumar; NVIDIA/Caltech/UT Austin/Stanford/UCLA, 2023)
lineage: MineDojo (2022, the same lab's Minecraft simulation suite) -> Voyager (2023): the first LLM-driven lifelong-learning agent with a persistent, growing, retrievable skill library

license.evidence: GitHub API license field + LICENSE in repo

dependencies: Node.js mineflayer 4.8.1 + mineflayer-pathfinder/pvp/tool/collectblock, prismarine-*, @babel/core (JS AST parsing for skill code)
a licensed Minecraft Java Edition client

example.command: python -c "from voyager import Voyager; v = Voyager(mc_port=..., openai_api_key=...); v.learn()"
example.input: a running Minecraft server + OpenAI API key (both require spending; not exercised here)

environment.note: needs a licensed Minecraft client + a paid OpenAI API key; not runnable on M3 without spending (standing rule: no spending without authorization). Source-level autopsy performed instead (voyager.py, agents/{skill,curriculum,action,critic}.py fetched and read in full at the pinned commit).

human_capability_summary.built_to: explore Minecraft indefinitely, inventing its own tasks, writing and reusing JavaScript programs as skills, without human task specification
human_capability_summary.pressure: single-task RL agents in Minecraft plateau; hand-designed curricula do not scale to open-ended exploration
human_capability_summary.success_means: 3.3x more unique items, 2.3x longer distances travelled, unlocking the tech tree up to 15.3x faster than the prior SOTA (paper's own comparison)

known_human_problem_solved: lifelong open-ended skill acquisition in a fixed but unbounded world, using an LLM as both curriculum proposer and code generator
behavioral_entry_point: Voyager.learn(): propose_next_task -> rollout (iterative code-gen/execute/critique up to action_agent_task_max_retries) -> on success, SkillManager.add_new_skill -> next proposal conditioned on updated completed/failed task lists

runtime.host_class: any host with Node.js + Python + a Minecraft licence + OpenAI credits

preservation.note: status is the worse of body_status and the recipe axis; a matching tree hash alone never implies completeness.
